title: {p} Paprikash with {v}
steps: Cook the {s} following the package directions and keep it warm.
Cut the {p} and the {v} into bite-size pieces. Cook in a hot pan with a little butter and oil, about 5 minutes, until {doneness}.
Stir in the {spice} for a minute. Add a splash of wine or broth, a squeeze of lemon and a spoonful of tomato paste, and simmer 5 minutes.
Turn the heat low and stir in the {sauce}. Warm gently for 3 minutes without boiling, then spoon over the {s}.
tip: Use plain Greek yogurt in place of sour cream, and double the peppers.
